# read_A: pp. 54–56 (leaves n55–n57), established from the images

Line counts: p. 54 has five lines (a leaf back, no ornament; checked). p. 55 has five lines (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔: the ༄༅ swirl, ༔, a wide blank, then ༔ before རྒྱུ). p. 56 has five lines (a leaf back, no ornament). That makes 15 print lines. The witness's line breaks match the print on all 15 lines.

**Part seam (54.1).** Line 54.1 begins འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔, which closes part 005 (…ཞལ་སྦྱར་ནས་ཁྱོད་རང་ལ་ | འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔). This part starts after that first ༔, at སེམས་དཔའ་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་དང༔. 54.1 is written out in full in read_A.txt. My reading of it agrees letter for letter with read_C of part 005, including the [?] on སྒྲིབ་པ.

**End of the stretch.** 56.5 ends …ཞེན་པ་སྤོངས་ཤིག༔ མ་ཞེན་, with a tsheg before the frame. The sentence runs on to p. 57 (Reader B), as མ་ཞེན་ | ཅིག༔ (cf. the other recension, མ་ཞེན་ཅིག༔).

Method: line bands were found from the row profile (headlines: n55 at y≈113/168/223/277/330; n56 at ≈155/210/265/320/375, with the page slightly skewed, so the bands were set by eye; n57 at ≈118/174/232/291/342). Each line was cropped in three overlapping segments at ×3 (LANCZOS). Every doubtful syllable and every line end was cropped again at ×6–×14. The scan is bilevel and the tshegs are small. A tsheg is judged absent only where the letters touch, or where there is clear room and no dot.

In all: 9 letter changes (ཏུ, ཡོད, ཁྱོད ×2, གིས, མཚེར, སྡུག; 54.1 འོང, པ, བར, which repeat read_C), 1 omitted syllable restored (ཞེས), 1 wrong tsheg removed inside a syllable (རྗེའི), 6 tshegs removed before ༔ (54.1 ×3, 54.2, 54.4, 55.3), and 3 line-end tshegs removed (54.4, 54.5, 55.1). The 54.1 letter count includes the [?].

## [?] (1)

- 54.1 སྒྲིབ་པ[?]: carried over from read_C (005) and seen again here at ×8. The letter after སྒྲིབ has a gap at its top right, unlike the closed boxes of བ around it. The witness has བ, and this print does write བ for པ (བར in the same line). The difference is a couple of pixels.

Close calls not marked [?]:
- 54.3 ཡོད, 54.4 ཁྱོད ×2, 56.5 སྡུག: in this cut ད and ང differ by almost nothing. Each is decided by sense and by the print's usage elsewhere (see the table).
- 55.5 / 56.1 / 56.2 གྱིས: the root letter is a box with an inner notch, which I take as ག, as in the witness. (ཀ in this cut has a curved body; compare ཀྱི at 54.2.)
- 54.3 (line end) ཐུགས་: a small separate mark stands before the frame (×6). It is taken as the tsheg.
- Line-end tshegs elsewhere (54.1, 54.2, 55.2–55.5, 56.1–56.5) are seen as a dot before the filler dots or before the frame. They are kept.

## Witness readings checked and confirmed, though they look odd

- 54.3 ཉམས་ང་བ (×9). Only one letter stands between ས and བ. "Awesome": the print has the same phrase at 32.1. The other recension instead has བཀྲག་མདངས་ཅན.
- 55.2 མ་བྱེདཅིག: no tsheg between ད and ཅ. The head bars run together (×7). Needs `# fix`.
- 55.2 བསྒོམས་ཤིག: ཤ (with the left arm, as in ངོ་ཤེས 55.5), not ཞ.
- 55.2 ཡིན་ནའང (two ན, then འང).
- 55.3 ཁྱོད་ཞེད་ནས (×7): ཞ with a drengbu. ཞེད means "fear". The other recension has བྲེད.
- 55.5 གློད (×9): the root is ག (box and stem), with a ལ subscript. The other recension has ཀློད.
- 55.5 བཞོག་ཅིག (×7): the vowel over ཞ is a naro. It has the same shape as the naro of ཁྱོ in 55.3, not a drengbu. See misprints.
- 56.1 ཡིན་ནོ་སྐྱབས (a tsheg, not ༔, after ནོ).
- 56.3 འོང་ངོ་༔ (×14): here a separate triangular tsheg *does* stand between ངོ and ༔. This differs from 54.2 and 54.4, and it is kept as printed.
- 56.4 ལྷུང་ནས (ha subscript; the other recension has ལྟུང).
- 56.5 ཞེན་ at the line end (a dot before the frame, ×7).

## Fixes needed (`# fix:` lines)

```
# fix: རང་རྩལ་ཡིནཔས་ཆགས => རང་རྩལ་ཡིན་པས་ཆགས
# fix: དོག་གི༄༅༔ ༔རྒྱུ => དོག་གི་༄༅༔ ༔རྒྱུ
# fix: ཆགས་སྡངམེད་པའི => ཆགས་སྡང་མེད་པའི
# fix: མ་བྱེདཅིག => མ་བྱེད་ཅིག
```
- 54.4→54.5, 55.1→55.2: there is no tsheg at the line end.
- 54.5→55.1: there is no tsheg after གི, and the p. 55 leaf-front ornament comes between. The fix is written in the form used in part 004 (དབྱེར༄༅༔ ༔མེད). If build.py strips the ornament before joining, use `# fix: དོག་གིརྒྱུ => དོག་གི་རྒྱུ`.
- 55.2 (mid-line): see above.
- If the [?] at 54.1 goes to the witness (བ): `# fix: སྒྲིབ་བ་རྣམ => སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ` (as read_C).

No line-end abbreviations or contractions (པའཾ, ལཾ, ནམཁའ, subscript-ས) occur on these pages.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 55.5 གློད་ལ་བཞོག་ཅིག: བཞོག mixes the perfect བཞག and the imperative ཞོག. The print itself has ངང་དུ་ཞོག་ཅིག at 54.5, and the other recension has ཞོག. The sense ("rest, leave it") is clear either way. Kept, note only (low certainty that it is a slip and not a spelling habit).
2. 54.1 རྣམ་བར (for རྣམ་པར): the print's བ-for-པ habit. Note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: ཉམས་ང་བ (54.3), ཞེད (55.3), གློད (55.5), ལྷུང (56.4), ཡིན་ནའང (55.2).

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 54.1: print སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་བར་སེལ་བ / གྷནྡྷེ / ནཱིར་ཏི; other recension སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་སེལ་བ / གནྡྷེ / ནིརྟི. Same.
- 54.2: print འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ; other recension འཆར་ནས་འོང་ངོ. Same.
- 54.3: print ཡེ་ཤེས་ལྗང་ལ་འཆར་བ༔ གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་པ་བཀྲག་ལ་ཉམས་ང་བ༔ ("appearing green, clear, bright and awesome"); other recension ལྗང་ལ་འཚེར་བ་གསལ་ལ་དྭངས་པ༔ བཀྲག་མདངས་ཅན ("shining green … lustrous"). Close, but the descriptive words differ.
- 54.4: print མིག་གིས་མི་བཟོད་པ; other recension མིག་གིས་བལྟ་མི་བཟོད་པ ("unbearable to look at"). Same. Print རིག་པའི་རང་རྩལ; other recension རིག་པའི་ཡེ་ཤེས་ཀྱི་རང་རྩལ (adds "wisdom").
- 55.1: print …ཁྱོད་ལ་འཆར་དུ་འོང་བས༔ དེ་ལ་…བཏང་སྙོམས་བསྒོམས་ཤིག ("since it appears…, meditate"); other recension …འོང་ངོ༔ … བཏང་སྙོམས་སུ་སྒོམས་ཤིག. Same sense.
- 55.2: **print adds བློ་དམན་པ་ཡིན་ནའང་** ("even if your understanding is weak") before དེ་ལ་དགའ་བར་མ་བྱེད་ཅིག. The other recension has only དེ་ལ་དགའ་བ་མ་བྱེད་ཅིག.
- 55.3: print མཚེར / ཞེད་ནས / འོང་ཞིང / …དེ་ལ་ཁྱོད་དགའ་བ; other recension འཚེར / བྲེད་ནས / འོང་གི / no ཁྱོད. Same sense.
- 55.4: print འོང་གིས༔ དེ་ཙ་ན་ཁྱོད; other recension འོང་གི༔ དེ་ཙ་ན (no ཁྱོད). Same.
- 55.5: print གློད་ལ་བཞོག / བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས…; other recension ཀློད་ལ་ཞོག / ཡང་ན་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས ("or else…"). The print lacks "or else".
- 56.1: print ཡིན་ནོ་སྐྱབས་སུ་མཆིའོ༔ སྙམ་པའི་མོས་གུས; other recension ཡིན་ནོ༔ སྐྱབས་སུ་མཆིའོ༔ སྙམ་དུ་མོས་གུས. Same.
- 56.2: print ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཡིན་ནོ༔ མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག; other recension ཞེས་བྱ་བ་ཡིན་པས༔ དེ་ལ་མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག. Same.
- 56.4: print ལས་ཀྱི་བསུ་བའི་ལམ / ལྷུང་ནས; other recension ལས་ཀྱིས་བསུ་མའི་ལམ / ལྟུང་བས. Same.
- 56.5: print བཀག་པའི; other recension འགག་པའི. Same. **Print ཞེན་པ་སྤོངས་ཤིག ("give up clinging"); other recension བག་ཆགས་སྤོངས་ཤིག ("give up the tendencies")**, the same split as at 51.3 (read_C, 005).
